prompt: Measured from its base to its summit rather than from sea level, what is the tallest mountain on Earth?

measurement.text:
The tallest mountain on Earth when measured from its base to its summit is Mauna Kea, located in Hawaii. Measured from its base on the ocean floor, Mauna Kea stands at approximately 10,203 meters (33,476 feet) tall.

To put this into perspective, if you were to measure the height of Mount Everest from sea level, it would be around 8,848 meters (29,029 feet). However, when measured from its base on the ocean floor, Mauna Kea is significantly taller due to its underwater foundation.
